name: remember
description: Continuous memory for Claude Code. Extracts, summarizes, and compresses conversations into tiered daily logs. Claude remembers what you did yesterday.

oauth_token.title: Recovery OAuth token
oauth_token.description: Optional. Only needed if the nested `claude -p` summarizer call runs unauthenticated because your host does not give hook subprocesses your Claude Code login (see /remember:doctor). Leave blank to keep using your host's own login -- nothing is read from it without this.
